facts.fact: 中文：叙述者自称若在本《History》中说谎哪怕一个字，就把自己的身与魂、肚肠与内脏献给十万筐上等魔鬼。
facts.anchor: I offer myself, body and soul, tripe and bowels, to a hundred thousand basket-loads of fine devils in case I lie in so much as a single word in the whole of this History.

facts.fact: 中文：叙述者诅咒读者：让圣安东尼之火灼烧你、癫痫掀翻你、雷击与腿疮折磨你、痢疾抓住你。
facts.anchor: And, similarly, may St. Anthony’s fire burn you, the epilepsy throw you, the thunder-stroke and leg-ulcers rack you, dysentery seize you,

facts.fact: 中文：叙述者继续诅咒，让带细小牛毛疹的丹毒连同水银之痛从肛门钻入读者体内。
facts.anchor: and may the erysipelas, with its tiny cowhair rash, and quicksilver’s pain on top, through your arse-hole enter up,

facts.fact: 中文：叙述者诅咒读者像所多玛与蛾摩拉一样化为硫磺、火焰与无底深渊——前提是读者不坚信他在这部《Chronicle》里讲的一切。
facts.anchor: and like Sodom and Gomorrah may you dissolve into sulphur, fire, and the bottomless pit, in case you do not firmly believe everything that I tell you in this present Chronicle!

facts.fact: 中文：誓言的出处书名为《The Histories of Gargantua and Pantagruel》。
facts.anchor: The Histories of Gargantua and Pantagruel

facts.fact: 中文：出处标注为《Pantagruel》第二卷的作者序言，年份 1532。

facts.fact: 中文：署名作者为已故的 M. Alcofribas，头衔为「Abstractor of the Quintessence」。
